brief.headline: In Google's public demo dataset, revenue rose 60.7% to 38086, driven largely by the United States.
executive_summary: Revenue was 38086, up 60.7% from 23694; transactions were 563, up 53.8% from 366.
Sessions rose 15.1% to 25914, but conversion rate fell to 1.44 from 1.52.
United States revenue was 17492, up 86.5%, with a gap_vs_total_pts of 25.7.
Source attribution is partially obfuscated; channel-level conclusions need caution.

what_changed.title: Total revenue and transactions rose sharply
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 38086, up 60.7% from 23694; transactions were 563, up 53.8% from 366.

what_changed.title: Conversion rate declined
what_changed.detail: Conversion rate was 1.44, down 4.7% from 1.52, while sessions rose 15.1% to 25914.

what_changed.title: United States outperformed total
what_changed.detail: US revenue was 17492, up 86.5% from 9381, with gap_vs_total_pts of 25.7.

likely_drivers: The total revenue lift is likely concentrated in the United States, which had revenue of 17492, up 86.5%, and a gap_vs_total_pts of 25.7.
Higher revenue per session, 1.47 versus 1.05, is consistent with more value per visit rather than only more sessions.
Mobile transactions grew 75.5% to 258, which may have contributed to the total transaction increase.
risks: If the conversion-rate decline continues, future session growth may not translate into revenue.
If the US lift is not verified, channel decisions may rely on partially obfuscated source data.
High-interest products with zero purchases, such as Google Blue Stojo Cup with 1467 views and 0 purchase lines, may indicate a checkout or product-page issue.

actions.action: Audit the checkout flow for mobile and desktop to identify why conversion rate fell to 1.44 from 1.52.
actions.why: Sessions grew 15.1% but conversion rate declined 4.7%, suggesting a friction point in the purchase path.
actions.evidence: conversion_rate current 1.44, previous 1.52, change_pct -4.7; sessions current 25914, previous 22508, change_pct 15.1

actions.action: Investigate the United States revenue spike to confirm whether it is a demand story or a tracking artifact.
actions.why: US revenue grew 86.5% versus 60.7% total, with gap_vs_total_pts of 25.7, which is a large divergence.
actions.evidence: United States revenue current 17492, previous 9381, change_pct 86.5, gap_vs_total_pts 25.7

actions.action: Review product pages and pricing for Google Blue Stojo Cup, which has high views but zero purchases.
actions.why: The product has 1467 views and 99 adds to cart but 0 purchase lines, indicating a drop-off at the purchase step.
actions.evidence: Google Blue Stojo Cup views_cur 1467, adds_to_cart_cur 99, purchase_lines_cur 0, view_to_purchase_pct 0

data_caveats: This is Google's public obfuscated GA4 sample dataset, not a real client.
24.4% of session-level source rows are unknown or obfuscated; treat channel breakdowns with caution.
Calendar events are empty for both weeks, so no seasonality explanation is available from the payload.
